note: Described references only: no image is committed and nothing here is copied from another game's frames.

entries.source: genre comparable: macro photography of hand-built model dioramas (shallow depth of field at f/2, focus on a small figure)
entries.why: The shallow-focus miniature lens: one sharp acorn-sized hero, the set melting into soft bokeh in the foreground and background

entries.source: genre comparable: stop-motion puppet sets built from wool felt, modelling clay and painted wood
entries.why: Felt nap sheen on moss and toadstool caps, matte clay bodies with soft rounded edges, nothing glossy except lacquered caps

entries.source: nature comparable: forest-floor macro photography at dawn, golden hour and night (moss, toadstools, dandelion fluff, fireflies)
entries.why: Each world's hour as one light colour: low dawn shafts, golden hour, lava glow in a cellar, amber lantern light, cold moonlight
